mutations.catches: the sheet no longer reading Table 1 at all, so every score prints as +0 and +0
hit and damage printed in each other's place, which agree at most scores and not at 18/00
the column padding dropped, so a single-digit score shifts the bracket out of line with every other row
the sign dropped, so a bonus of 1 and a penalty of 1 both print as 1
an ordinary score printed as an exceptional one
a percentile of 100 printed as 18/100 rather than the 18/00 the book writes
a plain 18 printed as 18/00, since its percentile is zero

equivalent_note: AttackKind::MELEE changed to RANGED was tried here and survived, and it is equivalent rather than untested: AttackStrength::adjustment opens with 'if (kind == AttackKind::MELEE || missileWeapon == nullptr)', so a null weapon short-circuits the kind and both arms return the same row. No input distinguishes them at this call site. Derived by reading the source, not machine-checked. The argument is worth keeping as a statement of intent - the sheet prints a swing - but nothing can test that it says MELEE, and a mutant claiming otherwise is a false finding.
